title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Is adding Google Adsense in a website, and earn money through this Halaal? Google Adsense is actually an Advertisement platform, which is embedded in a website, which shows different sort of advertisement. Though they say that they dont show porn type of ads as per their policy, but there are other non shariah advertisements to be displayed. Though all the ads are not Non Shariah, but if talking about the non shariah ads displayed by Google Adsense,l some are the advertisements of Dating, Songs, Meat, Skulls, Christianity Promition, Adult Hosting, " You must be saved to go to Heaven" etc. But as said, all the advertisement are not non shariah and haraam only. Halaal ads are also displayed there. Now please look into this matter, and let us know if the income of such earning is Halaal or not, and if not Halaal then what action could be taken on that.. If the income coming from, is like 100,000 USD per month. 12485 views Q. When i joined university, i needed to secure a scholarship to gain entry to the institute, as my family was not well financed at that time. The scholarship was provided by the government ministry. However, i came to realise that the scholarship i received was not based merit, rather through some talks between my relatives and the scholarships officer behind the curtain (in secrecy). I also found out that my family had to offer some bribe to the officer in order to guarantee that i receive the scholarship for the degree of engineering. (1) Is that education which i received upon that scholarship unlawful to me? (2) I am currently working, is my income also unlawful due to receiving education where bribery was involoved. (3) I signed an agreement with the scholarships ministry (the government), where i would need to serve the country for the number of years i got the scholarship for i.e. 3 years, and it wasnt mentioned that i need to return that amount back to the government. I am almost completing my 3rd year of work on the country. Does it mean that i have to return the full amount of schlarship to the government of my country? 2475 views Q. Is there any mas'ala to eat chicken skin less or is it ok to eat chicken with skin 8464 views Q. I work in a Govt. Arms and Ammunition manufacturing unit under Ministry of Defence. A system called 'Outgoing Circular' is effective in our organisation in which a person or a group of people apply for outgoing facility for events like Diwali, Ganesh jayanti, Ambedkar jayanti, Ramdhan any many more events where they go out of the factory getting one time punching exemption and not to return for the day under the pretext of doing welfare work . In turn they get their Overtime booked for the whole day and get the pay accodingly. This type of facility is also availed by our muslim brethren in the holy month of Ramadhan. I want to ask whether taking this facility is jayaz as the overtime pay is granted if the person works in the factory beyond 8 hours of normal working. Please reply my query. May Allah give us all hidayat. 2664 views Q. I am a male can I watch video bayanat of male orator? 2435 views Q. I want to ask that sprit which is used to clean a wound is paak or naapaak. 2285 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 10053 Country: FR Title: Salam I was going through some magazines. I found one interesting question. A muslim boy asked that he has an audio cd of quran and its translation, and he want to install it on his computer, so his question was can he install quran cd on his laptop or not? Please answer this question. Question: Salam I was going through some magazines. I found one interesting question. A muslim boy asked that he has an audio cd of quran and its translation, and he want to install it on his computer, so his question was can he install quran cd on his laptop or not? Please answer this question. Answer ID: 10053 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 122/122=M/1429) It is allowable to install it with good intention provided there is no sound of woman and no desecration of the Quran, otherwise not. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
